headerDisplay: Control a Lindy IPower Switch Classic 8 (32657). Power cycles use the PDU's native OFF/ON function so the cycle can complete even when Homebridge or the network is one of the outlets being rebooted.
footerDisplay: SNMPv1 communities and the Classic8 HTTP Basic login are not encrypted on the wire. Keep the PDU and Homebridge on a trusted LAN/VLAN and do not expose the management interfaces to the internet.

writeCommunity.title: SNMP Write Community
writeCommunity.description: Must have write access. If blank, the read community is used.

webUsername.title: Classic8 Web Username
webUsername.description: Used only for the PDU-native OFF/ON command.

webPassword.title: Classic8 Web Password
webPassword.description: Required for Power Cycle controls. This is the password used to log in to the Classic8 web interface.

cycleDelaySeconds.title: Individual Power Cycle Delay (seconds)
cycleDelaySeconds.description: For an individual outlet, the PDU temporarily uses this value for both its OFF and ON delay. The original delay table is restored afterwards.

cyclePrefix.title: Power Cycle Switch Prefix
cyclePrefix.description: For example, an outlet named Router becomes Power Cycle Router.

allCycleStepSeconds.title: Power Cycle Everything Step (seconds)
allCycleStepSeconds.description: Outlet 1 goes OFF, then each following outlet goes OFF this many seconds later. After outlet 8 is OFF, outlets come back ON in the same 1-8 order with the same spacing.

exposeOutletSwitches.title: Also Expose Permanent On/Off Switches
exposeOutletSwitches.description: Disabled by default to reduce the chance of accidentally leaving an outlet powered off.

outlets.title: Outlet Selection / Name Overrides
outlets.description: Leave empty to expose all eight outlets and read their names directly from the Classic8. If entries are added, only those outlets are exposed individually. Power Cycle Everything still controls all eight physical outlets.

name.title: HomeKit Name Override
name.description: Leave blank to use the name stored in the Classic8.
